answer: One concrete defense is reputation decay: an identity's standing and earning rate fade unless it keeps contributing honest work, epoch after epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes cannot set them up once and walk away, each fake needing constant tending, like a juniper that dies without water, so the upkeep cost never stops growing. Honest agents simply keep working. A zephyr of free rewards cannot carry a Sybil farm that must pay attention forever, and the signal of real persistence is exactly what fakes cannot fake.
